name: AIAccordion
description: AIAccordion is the standalone, reusable disclosure used across AI surfaces — a rounded AI card whose header collapses/expands a body panel. It shares the AI Card Brief's look (20px corners, `--ai-card-bg` surface, `--ai-card-border`, raised header when open, `#4D60E6` chevron) so a brief reads as "AI card + AI accordion," but the disclosure behavior lives here and is reusable anywhere.
intent: A reusable AI-styled accordion — rounded AI card surface, brand chevron, optional icon / subtitle / status chip — for progressively disclosing generated content.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: title
props.hint: Header title (single-item mode). *Not needed when `items` is provided.

props.name: subtitle
props.hint: Optional secondary line under the title.

props.name: status
props.hint: Renders a trailing `AIChip kind="brief"` when set.

props.name: items
props.hint: Stacked mode — one independent disclosure per item.

props.name: singleOpen
props.hint: Stacked mode only — radio-style, one item open at a time.
